models.name: ggml-large-v3-turbo-q5_0
models.note: Recommended. Distilled from large-v3 with ~0.5% WER regression but ~8x faster. ~574 MB, roughly realtime on a modern CPU. Closest open-source match to commercial dictation quality. Multilingual.

models.name: ggml-small.en
models.note: Fast mode. English-only. ~466 MB, 3-5x realtime on a typical CPU. Noticeably worse than turbo on names and technical speech.

models.name: ggml-base.en
models.note: Balanced for weak hardware. ~148 MB, sub-second inference on an average CPU.

models.name: ggml-tiny.en
models.note: Fastest. Good for drafts and casual notes on older hardware. ~78 MB.

models.name: ggml-medium.en
models.note: English-only legacy large. Prefer large-v3-turbo-q5_0 instead — same quality tier, smaller download, multilingual.
